summary: Host Digital Inc. (formerly Healthy Choice Wellness Corp.) filed an 8-K reporting the September 17, 2026 closing of its merger with Host Digital Infrastructure LLC, announced May 27, 2026. Merger Sub merged into Host DI, which survived as a wholly owned subsidiary; all Host DI common and preferred units converted into Parent Class A common stock or $0.001-exercise pre-funded warrants. No price, premium, or board recommendation disclosed. Registration Rights Agreements grant resale shelf rights, implying material share overhang. Watch for resale registration timing and post-close float/ownership dilution dynamics.
